from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def task_func(data_dict, data_keys):
    x_key, y_key = data_keys
    x_vals = [float(v) for v in data_dict[x_key]]
    y_vals = [float(v) for v in data_dict[y_key]]

    corr_coef, _ = stats.pearsonr(x_vals, y_vals)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.scatter(x_vals, y_vals)
    ax.set_xlabel(str(x_key))
    ax.set_ylabel(str(y_key))

    return corr_coef, ax
